task.title: Add global settings panel with Yolo mode toggle
task.description: Add a settings panel to the GUI that allows users to toggle "Yolo mode" (--dangerously-skip-permissions). The settings panel should be accessible via a settings icon button in the header/toolbar area, opening as a shadcn Popover component.
task.problem: The GUI currently has no way to enable "Yolo mode" (--dangerously-skip-permissions), which is essential for frictionless automation as recommended by GSD. Users who want skip-permissions behavior must configure it outside the GUI, breaking the workflow.
task.value: Users can toggle Yolo mode directly from the GUI, enabling seamless automation without constant permission prompts. This aligns with how GSD recommends running Claude Code for maximum productivity.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a user is viewing the GUI When they look at the header/toolbar area Then they see a settings icon button
Given a user clicks the settings icon button When the popover opens Then they see a toggle switch for "Yolo mode" And they see a description explaining what Yolo mode does And they see red-highlighted warning text about the potential danger
Given a user enables the Yolo mode toggle When Claude processes are spawned Then the --dangerously-skip-permissions flag is passed to the CLI
Given a user has enabled Yolo mode When they close and reopen the GUI Then the Yolo mode setting persists (remains enabled)
Given a user disables the Yolo mode toggle When Claude processes are spawned Then the --dangerously-skip-permissions flag is NOT passed
